howToApply: Step 1 – Application Fee: Pay non-refundable application fee via NEFT only in favor of ‘Executive Director, AIIMS-Bilaspur’. SC/ST/PwBD candidates are exempted. Others pay Rs. 2,000 + 18% GST = Rs. 2,360/-. Bank: State Bank of India, Bilaspur; Account No: 42734198120; IFSC: SBIN0063972. Upload proof of payment in the Google Form.

Step 2 – Download Application Forms: Download Appendix-I (Application Form), Appendix-II (Career Graph in MS Word, Times New Roman Font Size 12, save as PDF), and Appendix-III (Presentation in PPT format) from the provided links.

Step 3 – Submit Google Form: Fill and submit the Google Form at https://forms.gle/DGvRFdBmXoghGqCg7 along with scanned copies of application forms and required documents. The Google Form link remains active till 14.12.2026 up to 05:00 PM.

Step 4 – Submit Offline Application: Send duly filled and signed hard copy (Appendix-I) along with self-attested copies of all relevant certificates (age, qualification, experience, proof of payment, caste/EWS/PwBD certificate, NOC, etc.) to: Deputy Director (Administration), Administrative Block, 3rd Floor, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Kothipura, Bilaspur, Himachal Pradesh-174037. The envelope must be superscribed: ‘Application for the post of ………, Department of ………… for AIIMS, Bilaspur (H.P.)’. Must reach by 21.12.2026 by 05:00 PM.
Candidates already employed in Central/State Govt./Autonomous Institutions must route their applications through proper channel with NOC, Vigilance, Integrity and Penalty certificates.
For more than one post, submit separate applications for each post.

vacancyList.postName: Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders)

howToApply: Candidates must first register on the respective NAPS/NATS Portal based on their trade: For Trade Apprentice (DEO/DDEO): https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in; For Technician Apprentice and Trade Apprentice (HR/Accountant): https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php

Login to the respective NATS/NAPS Portal using User ID/Email ID and apply for the apprenticeship openings using the Establishment ID of Indian Oil Corporation Limited (Pipelines Division) for the relevant region.

After applying on NAPS/NATS Portal, visit the Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/ and complete Part-I registration by filling basic details (name, category, etc.) and creating a password. Note the system-generated registration number sent to your email/SMS.

Login again with the registration number and password to complete Part-II registration: upload scanned colour photograph (20-50 KB, JPG) and signature in black ink (10-30 KB, JPG), and furnish educational qualification and experience details.
Submit the application. After final submission, details cannot be changed. Take a printout of the filled-in online application for future reference.
Ensure the same e-mail ID and mobile number used in NAPS/NATS Portal are used in the Indian Oil Pipelines portal.
The application window is from 06.11.2026 to 05.12.2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.
